title: open_account
description: Open one of the signed-in customer's accounts and show its list of transactions. Use this when the customer refers to a particular account or card they want to look at — most often the card carrying a charge they do not recognise. If they name the kind of account rather than an id, pass accountType and leave accountId unset; the app resolves it. Opening an account replaces whatever account was previously shown.

accountId.description: Opaque id of the account to open, if the customer or prior context identified a specific one.

accountType.description: The kind of account to open when no specific id is known, e.g. the customer says 'my credit card'.
